manifest.criteria: benefit iff the paired-bootstrap 95% CI of (arm - control) holdout MSE lies below 0, the median holdout MSE is lower, and the upper-quartile (lower-quartile performance) holdout MSE is lower; harm iff the CI lies above 0; otherwise no-benefit. Confirmatory test: the one cell chosen on calibration seeds. All other cells are exploratory.

selfLoops.path: recurrent: forwardOnly false, feedbackLoop true, disableRandomSamples true; scored with feedbackLoop true over the records in order, state cleared once per score
selfLoops.reason: the grid cells run on the forward-only path (the production default); self-loops are tested only on the already-supported recurrent path, as one exploratory arm: the control topology plus a self-loop on every hidden neuron
